items.title: 54270_Doc Cheatham oral history interview
items.q: we had a fellow by the name of George Dewey Washington. Who was very popular and Walter Richardson... George Dewey Washington, and Walter Richardson, would sing at the Dreamland

ctx.x: Now when you were at the Dreamland, I meant to ask you, were there any singers with the band at the Dreamland?
Well, we had a fellow by the name of George Dewey Washington. Who was very popular and Walter Richardson.
